what: Palantir builds software platforms (Gotham, Foundry, AIP) that let governments and companies combine large amounts of data and use AI to make decisions.
customers: US and allied defense and intelligence agencies, and large companies in manufacturing, healthcare, energy and finance.
money: defense and intelligence contracts in the US and abroad
Foundry and AIP subscriptions for companies
moat: Deep integration in sensitive government work, security clearances and software that becomes the operating layer of its customers.
opportunities: Revenue grew about 56% last year and about 33% a year over three years
Operating margin of 32% with cash of $10.6 billion and almost no debt
US commercial customer count has been growing very quickly
watch: US commercial revenue growth and net new customer additions.
